The background consists of thin trees and foliage. The bison is dark brown with a shaggy coat, particularly around the head and shoulders.

The eye is visible as a dark spot on the side of the head, consistent with the description.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and partially obscured by the thick fur of the head, matching the 'hidden in fur' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, shaggy dark brown fur. The shoulder hump is prominent and well-defined.
The fur on the rear half of the body appears shorter and smoother compared to the dense mane and shoulder fur, consistent with bison anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.

The lower legs and feet are obscured by the terrain (sand/dirt mound) and the wire fence mesh makes detailed verification of hooves impossible.
